title: Memory to store the quantum state of N spins, in bytes
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Storing every amplitude of N spin-one-half particles takes 2 to the N complex numbers; at 16 bytes each that is 16 kilobytes for 10 spins, 17 megabytes for 20, 17 gigabytes for 30, 18 terabytes for 40, 18 petabytes for 50 and 18 exabytes for 60. A worked example: the arithmetic is this frame's.
heading: BYTES TO STORE 2ᴺ AMPLITUDES (LOG SCALE)
